#41189 is the next chapter of the Fredholm story. It defines Fredholm operators, and proves the equivalence of four characterization for Fredholmness, all for arbitray TVSs over any complete docs#NontriviallyNormedField. I'm very very happy about the resulting code, I think it is very clean, and we are once again beating Bourbaki in generality.

Many thanks to @Filippo A. E. Nuccio @Yongxi Lin (Aaron) @Jon Bannon @Oliver Nash and @Patrick Massot for their participation in the project at ICERM, as well as @Sharvil Kesarwani @Calix Wei and @Monica Omar for their help on the prerequisites.
Note that it has some nontrivial dependencies, so this is not fully ready for review yet. But I hope to attract eyes on these blocking PRs :innocent:
I just had a look, but following the chain of dependencies I land on #41511 which you have just marked as awaiting-author.
Yes, I will remove one statement (waiting on #maths > A conjecture about modular lattices) to move forward.
